verses.text: Biblica, Inc. has prohibited me from using the NIV translation; they have chosen financial profit over the free dissemination of the Gospel. In the words of Jesus: "No one can serve two masters". The Word of God ought to be free and accessible, especially when a publisher prides itself on the scholarly work behind its translation. Yet these hypocritical "non-profit" organizations go to such extremes in order to raise the maximum possible donations for the purpose of distributing printed versions of their translations worldwide "free of charge," and, nevertheless, they will dispatch a cadre of attorneys to sue you and compel you to cease spreading your translation freely throughout the world. Apparently only they possess the right to do so; only they consider themselves sufficiently noble and just to engage in such acts. Bolls.life is developed and operated at my own expense for the sake of the Gospel. I am glad to fund it personally; money is not the issue, it is my sacrifice for the Gospel. Anyone and anywhere has access to the Bible without any fee, subscription, payment, authentication or authorization, or any form of advertising — "Sola Scriptura"! I only wish that publishers would share the same intention in their hearts. • From today onward, choose truly free translations such as YLT, WEB, ASV, KJV, NET, etc. • Send your "blessings" to Biblica via: https://www.biblica.com/contact/. • Share the truth about their practices.
